values.meaning: Total Magic Damage (initial + aftereffect), wiki-computed sum of two applications
values.binNote: This is the wiki's own doubling of MorganaR#TotalDamage (base [200,275,350], ap 0.8) to show the combined total across the initial hit and the aftereffect hit; the bin has no separate row for the summed total, it only stores the per-hit values used twice.

values.meaning: Tether duration before stun aftereffect triggers
values.quote: forming a {{tip|tether}} between herself and each target for 3 seconds

mechanics.claim: Damage lands on cast over the cast time, applying to all nearby enemy champions and forming a tether that lasts 3 seconds.
mechanics.quote: latches chains of energy onto nearby enemy champions over the cast time, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and forming a {{tip|tether}} between herself and each target for 3 seconds

mechanics.claim: If the tether is not broken by its end, the same magic damage is dealt again and the target is stunned.
mechanics.quote: If a target does not break their tether by the end of its duration, they are dealt the same {{as|magic damage}} again and become {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a duration

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the tether's application and initial damage but not the aftereffect damage/stun of an already-applied tether.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the tether's application and initial damage but not the aftereffects of one already applied.

mechanics.claim: An enemy champion within 575 units is required to cast; target need not be visible.
mechanics.quote: An enemy champion within {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 575 units is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be tethered by this ability.
